reasons: Claimed status is compliant with no redline and no comment, which is the expected output shape; the rendered paragraphs are unchanged from the originals.

The cited paragraphs contain no audit, inspection, records-examination or usage-verification right binding the Customer; p0001's 'access, support and cooperation' is operational delivery cooperation, not an audit or system-access right, and p0023 imposes no verification mechanic on us.

Absence of any audit obligation against the Customer is better than the preferred position (no audits at all vs. once per 12 months on 30 days' notice), so no redline is warranted and flagging a deviation would be over-reaching.
The failed deterministic check ('audit frequency limited') is expected and non-probative here: there is no audit clause to constrain, so the frequency regex could not match.

The rationale's note about potentially seeking audit rights against Kubient's 'as measured by Kubient' reporting is correctly identified as out of scope for this Customer-facing rule and is not raised as a negotiation issue.
